title: Alchemist perks: Stack Potions, Standless Brewing and Brewmaster
summary: A new perk class, the Alchemist. Stack Potions lets identical potions stack in your inventory. Standless Brewing gives you your own brewing stand, opened from a button in your inventory, that keeps brewing while you play and refuels itself over time. Brewmaster makes the potions you brew come out stronger.
